body.message:
Good Morning,

I hope you are doing well. Please find the answers to your questions below:

Are all bills included, including AC? – Yes, all bills are included.

Is there any possibility to change the sofa? – Unfortunately, it is not possible to make any changes to the apartment furnishings.

The payment is monthly, but can we choose the deduction date? – We can accommodate monthly payments.

Is a parking space included? – yes, you will have the 1 parking space

Weekly cleaning service – Cleaning is not included from our side, as outside cleaning teams are not permitted in Holiday Homes.

However, if needed, you may coordinate with the reception, and they will be happy to assist you.

Please let us know if you have any further questions or if you would like to proceed.
